scripts.typecheck: node scripts/ensure-web-dist.ts && wrangler types && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.deploy:dev: pnpm run db:migrate:dev && pnpm --filter web build --mode dev && wrangler deploy --env dev
scripts.deploy:prod: pnpm run db:migrate:prod && pnpm --filter web build && wrangler deploy --env ''
scripts.db:migrate:dev: wrangler d1 migrations apply maunedas-dev --env dev --remote
scripts.db:seed:dev: wrangler d1 execute maunedas-dev --env dev --remote --file seeds/0001_lookups.sql
